verdict.rationale: Rive's MCP integration is explicitly aimed at letting AI handle repetitive, high-volume work, such as creating state machines with hundreds of states or layers, view models, layouts and shapes. RML lets agents create and modify file content as text, which enables scripted mass edits. Components push source changes to all their instances, a form of one-to-many update. Missing for 10: a documented batch-edit or multi-select operation for existing items, bulk operations across multiple files or assets, concrete examples of agent-driven bulk modification (beyond creation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
